title_zh: 调整虚构劫案短剧的声音提示

scenario.label_zh: 虚构劫案戏剧声效排练
scenario.goal_zh: 用低音量台外呼喊提示劫案情节，约定演员听到呼喊后转身而不用突发巨响

context_zh: 成年人排练虚构舞台短剧，只讨论叙事声音与表演提示，不演练真实犯罪。
author: author-phase09-a

sentences.speaker: Rosa
sentences.text: The script says two characters rob a shop, but the audience never sees the shop. How will they know what happened?

sentences.speaker: Dylan
sentences.text: The next line mentions the robbery. Before that, a scream comes from offstage.

sentences.speaker: Rosa
sentences.text: The sound recording is so loud that it will scare people rather than help them follow the story.

sentences.speaker: Dylan
sentences.text: Then use a brief live cry at a lower volume. No sudden bang.

sentences.speaker: Rosa
sentences.text: And I turn toward the side door when I hear it?

sentences.speaker: Dylan
sentences.text: Yes. Wait for the cry, turn, and then deliver your line.

sentences.speaker: Rosa
sentences.text: All right. Let us practise from the moment before the cry, with that quieter cue.
